content: Isha Agarwal asked Anita Sharma to confirm the renewal premium of ₹25,500 per annum with a 5% online discount and inquire about any extra fees and next steps. Anita confirmed the amount, stated no additional fees, and provided a payment link and renewal form, instructing Isha to complete and return the form to finalize the renewal.

action_items: Customer to fill out and return the renewal form
Customer to make payment via the provided link
Agent to process renewal upon receipt of form and payment
